assessments.quote: competitive with nnU-Net (0.823 Dice, 88M parameters) and far above SAM (0.705) and MedSAM (0.439)

assessments.quote: Polyp-VSSD, a novel local-global joint decoding framework built upon a pre-trained Transformer backbone for high-precision polyp segmentation
assessments.reason: Polyp segmentation with a Transformer decoder; no mention of MedSAM or nnU-Net, so no evidence for either method or their differences.

assessments.quote: whether HER2 status can be predicted directly from whole-brain post-contrast T1-weighted (T1w) MRI scans in breast cancer brain metastases (BCBM) using deep learning
assessments.reason: Downstream HER2 prediction from MRI; no MedSAM or nnU-Net evidence and no method comparison relevant to the question.

assessments.quote: MedCaseAgent, an end-to-end agentic reasoning paradigm that bridges this gap by synthesizing publication-quality reports from unstructured clinical notes
assessments.reason: LLM agent for rare disease case reports; unrelated to MedSAM or nnU-Net segmentation.

assessments.quote: CG-MedSAM investigates contrast-conditioned parameter-efficient adaptation of MedSAM for skin-lesion segmentation across skin tones and imperfect bounding-box prompts.
assessments.reason: Provides MedSAM adaptation evidence (prompt-based, parameter-efficient) but no nnU-Net comparison or discussion of differences.

assessments.quote: The present paper introduces the nnU-Net ('no-new-Net'), which refers to a robust and self-adapting framework on the basis of 2D and 3D vanilla U-Nets.
assessments.reason: Original nnU-Net framework paper describing self-adapting U-Net-based design, preprocessing and training; foundational evidence for the nnU-Net side of the comparison.

assessments.quote: we present nnU-Net ('no-new-Net'), a framework that automatically adapts itself to any given new dataset
assessments.reason: Foundational nnU-Net description of automatic configuration and simple U-Net training scheme; direct evidence for nnU-Net characteristics.

assessments.quote: this paper introduces an extended version of the nnU-Net architecture for brain tumor segmentation
